description: Get latest marine fuel (bunker) prices returned for the account, one row per port and fuel, each with the currency, unit, as-of time, age in days and stale flag the API reports. Use when the user asks about bunker fuel, marine fuel, VLSFO, MGO, IFO380, or shipping fuel costs. Filter by port name or UN/LOCODE (e.g., Singapore or SGSIN, Rotterdam or NLRTM) and/or by the fuel type the API reports: VLSFO, MGO_05S (MGO), HFO_380 (IFO380). Requires an eligible account entitlement. Use opa_get_plans for current access and pricing; the API response is authoritative.

fuel_type.description: Filter by fuel type as the API reports it: VLSFO, MGO_05S (MGO also matches), HFO_380 (IFO380 also matches)

port.description: Filter by port name or UN/LOCODE, case-insensitive (e.g., 'Singapore' or 'SGSIN', 'Houston' or 'USHOU')

name: opa_get_marine_fuels
title: Get Marine Fuel Prices
